summary.text: Marcus Richmond is serving his sixth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 52, which includes portions of Scott, Yell and Sebastian counties.

paragraphs.text: His past service includes House Majority Leader in 2018, and he chairs the House side of the Joint Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs for the 95th General Assembly.
He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Physical Education from Arkansas Tech University, is president and CEO of America's Pet Registry Inc., and lives in Harvey.
